SELECT m.L1_model, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM model m
JOIN model_score ms ON m.name = ms.name AND m.version = ms.version AND m.step = ms.step
WHERE ms.model != 'Stack'
GROUP BY m.L1_model
ORDER BY count DESC
